display.purpose: Section headings and the H1 (clamp(2rem,10vw,3.25rem) on phones, clamp(2.6rem,3.9vw,3.5rem) from 64rem), the Closing heading (to 3.75rem) and the About name (to 4.25rem). Tomorrow italic 300, uppercase, 0.06em.

headline.purpose: List-row titles, dialog titles, the featured treatment and the session-footage title. Same lettering at 1.5-2.5rem.

title.purpose: Sub-headings inside dialogs and sheets at 1.25rem.

lede.purpose: The sentence under a heading, the hero promise on desktop, dialog excerpts; 52-62ch.

body.purpose: Reading text; 52-68ch. Footer and dialog detail lists at 0.9375rem; testimonial quotes at 1.25-1.375rem.

label.purpose: Nav links, buttons, field labels, tabs, technique lists, footer column headings, testimonial author. Tomorrow italic 500 uppercase 0.1em; buttons step 0.75 / 0.8125 / 0.875rem.

label-small.purpose: Hour names on the axis, title-block and footer definition terms, the mobile credential line.

stamp.purpose: Times, dates, counters and phone numbers: tabular italic figures at 300 (rest) or 400 (chosen), 0.04em. 0.875rem for dates and counters, 1.25-1.5rem for hours, 34-42 units in the drawing.

shadows.name: floating-sheet

shadows.name: fixed-action

shadows.name: scrim-dialog

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: The only easing. Light settling to the chosen hour, markers riding the axis, apertures lighting, dialogs rising.

motion.name: sun-arrive

motion.purpose: The one sweep on arrival: the beam grows from the window into the room once per page load.

motion.name: hour-change

motion.name: aperture-light

motion.name: marker-ride

motion.name: state-colour

motion.name: arrow-nudge

motion.name: accordion
motion.purpose: Benefit panels opening and the plus icon rotating 45 degrees.

motion.name: dialog
motion.value: in 350ms ease-settle from y 32px; out 200ms ease-in to y 32px
motion.purpose: Dialog rising onto the sheet and leaving.

motion.name: mobile-menu
motion.purpose: The mobile navigation panel dropping under the header.

motion.name: fade
motion.purpose: Tab panels and testimonial slides crossfading.

motion.name: fixed-action-reveal

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation-duration 0.01ms; drawing transitions 0; scroll-behavior auto; slider autoplay off

narrative.overview:
The whole site is one architectural section cut through an Abu Dhabi home, drawn on limewash and read across a day. Walls, slabs and the ground the building stands on are indigo poché, the solid of everything the section cuts through; the sun is the logo's gold and is the only thing that moves. Richard stands at the open front door with the folded table, and a dashed outline by the window shows where it will go. Choosing an hour moves the sun through the rooms, restamps the time on the drawing and, only once the visitor has chosen, carries that hour into the WhatsApp message. The brief, not the brand book, sets the manner: skilled and clinical in substance, premium in manner, and the proof is the person and the home visit itself.

The density is that of a drawing sheet: wide margins, one-pixel rules, hairline leaders and ticks, lettering in tracked inclined capitals, long measures of reading text, and nothing framed in a card. Sections alternate limewash, a pale indigo shadow tint, and full indigo poché; photographs are set as apertures cut into the indigo and rest in shadow until the light reaches them. Controls are sharp rectangles with no radius anywhere.

Confirmed refusals: no photo-hero wellness template, no rows of benefit cards, no eyebrows or kickers above headings, no rounded corners, no prices, ratings or counts, no decorative motion beyond the light.
keyCharacteristics: Limewash ground with indigo poché for walls, slabs, the ground and the footer.
Gold reserved for light (the beam, the sun, the lamp) and the active mark.
Green reserved for the action and living things.
Inclined drafted capitals (Tomorrow italic) over plain reading text (Barlow).
One-pixel rules, leaders and dimension ticks instead of boxes and shadows.
Photographs as apertures that come into colour mid-viewport.
Only light moves, with one sweep on arrival.

rules.name: The Gold Is Light Rule
rules.body: Gold appears only where light falls or where the visitor's choice is marked. It never fills a button, never colours a heading, and never decorates.

rules.name: The Green Is The Action Rule
rules.body: Green is the WhatsApp action and living things. One green action per composition on each ground; on indigo it keeps the same green and gains a limewash keyline (1px solid rgba(242,243,239,0.8)) rather than changing colour.

rules.name: The Poché Rule
rules.body: Indigo is the solid the section cuts through. It is a ground (About, Closing, footer), a cut (reveals, thick top rules), or a line (keylines, headings), never a tint. The one tint, shadow, marks withdrawn regions and is never a text colour.

rules.name: The Lettering Rule
rules.body: Anything that names, labels or commands is set in Tomorrow italic capitals; anything that explains is set in Barlow. There is no third voice and no upright heading.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: A section heading is a heading and a lede, nothing above it. Context comes from the drawing, the rule and the ground, not from an eyebrow.

rules.name: The Stamp Rule
rules.body: Figures that are times, dates, counts or phone numbers are stamps: tabular, italic, light. They are never set in Barlow.

rules.name: The One Sheet Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the page casts a shadow. Only things that leave the sheet (dialog, floating action, form sheet) may, and their shadow is ink-tinted, long and soft, never a hard offset.

rules.name: The Light Moves Rule
rules.body: Motion belongs to light: the beam and sun settle to the chosen hour in 1.2s, the beam sweeps once on arrival in 1.6s, the gold marker rides the axis in 0.5s, apertures come into colour in 1s, the nav underline grows in 0.5s, all on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). Interface state (hover colour 200ms, accordion 300ms, dialog 350ms in / 200ms out, mobile menu 250ms, tab and slide fades 350-400ms) changes quietly and nothing else travels. prefers-reduced-motion collapses every animation to 0.01ms and the drawing transitions to zero.

dos: Do set every heading, label, control and stamp in Tomorrow italic capitals and every explanation in Barlow; keep ledes at 52-62ch and body at 52-68ch.

Do use gold only for light and the active mark: the beam, the sun, the hour marker, the arrival tick, the active underline, the selected tab, the sunlit sill, the chosen stars, selection and the focus ring on indigo.
Do use green for the WhatsApp action and living things, and on indigo grounds keep the same green with a 1px limewash keyline.
Do build lists as ruled rows (1px indigo on top, 1px mortar between, 28px rows) and hang sequences from a 1px axis with ticks.
Do set photographs as apertures: indigo ground, greyscale under an indigo multiply, colour and a 4px gold sill when they reach the middle of the viewport, in an 8-10px indigo reveal on limewash.
Do keep controls as sharp rectangles 44px or taller, and keep the hour out of the WhatsApp message until the visitor has chosen one.
Do mark a section's ground with data-ground='poche' when it is indigo, so focus rings turn gold.
Do alternate grounds down the page (limewash, shadow tint, indigo) and let the drawing, not a card, carry the composition.
donts: Don't add an eyebrow, kicker or small-caps line above a heading.
Don't round a corner, anywhere; the drawing's own rx values are furniture, not interface.
Don't fill a button with gold or indigo-tint, or use gold as a text colour on limewash (the sun fails contrast on the ground; sun-deep exists for that case).
Don't put a shadow under anything that stays on the sheet; only the dialog, the form sheet and the fixed mobile action leave it, and never with a hard offset.
Don't animate anything but light and quiet state changes; nothing slides, scales or parallaxes on scroll.
Don't show prices, ratings, client counts or verified marks; the testimonial carries a name and a date only.
Don't frame content in cards or boxes; use rules, reveals and ground changes.
Don't use pure black or pure grey; scrims and shadows are ink at partial opacity, rules are mortar or on-poché.
